question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word 'opacity' in the given sentence.

The diminishing and deteriorating visibility in winter leads to the revival of accident cases on the highway.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (Visibility)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"opacity"** means the state of being opaque or not transparent; it refers to a lack of clarity or transparency. (अस्पष्टता)

 
 
• **Example:** The opacity of the frosted glass ensures privacy in the office.
 
 
 
• **"Visibility"** is the antonym of "opacity." It refers to the state of being able to see or be seen clearly; it indicates clarity or transparency. (दृश्यता)
 
 
• **Example:** The visibility on the highway improved after the fog lifted.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **"opacity"** is **"visibility."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (Visibility)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Diminishing** (घटता हुआ): Becoming smaller or less significant.

 
 
• **Example:** The diminishing light of the sunset created a serene atmosphere.
 
 
 
• **Revival** (पुनर्जीवन): The act of bringing something back to life or into use.
 
 
• **Example:** The revival of traditional crafts has boosted the local economy.
 
 
 
• **Deteriorating** (बिगड़ता हुआ): Becoming progressively worse.
 
 
• **Example:** The deteriorating condition of the roads makes travel dangerous.
